analysis_method: Static inspection of uploaded archive and seven effective views: base alone, or base plus exactly one version-targeted overlay (overlay ranges are disjoint). No Minecraft commands executed and no game/server runtime test. Functions can remain callable by an administrator even when no normal gameplay entry path is identified.
standard_material_rejections_scope: sword/pickaxe/axe/shovel/hoe/bow/crossbow; stage V netherite check also covers armor

familiarity.script_effect_status: sign and rounding require Java runtime confirmation; do not promise working repair

issues.summary: Current anvil/open only invokes station scan; anvil/process requires positive attw_anvil_t and no code in base/overlays sets it positive. Old manual repair, detailed history button and armor reforge have no normal session entry.

forge/open routes tracked copper/iron/diamond armor to generic equipment menus. Generic diamond reforge charges 2/3/4 diamonds but dispatch only contains five weapon/tool types, so an armor item can pay with no transformation. Gameplay reproduction still required.
Forge volley requires applied.longshot; new station bow_long modifier sets applied.bow_long. A new item following only station progression does not obtain the required old marker.
Netherite shield smithing recipe accepts any minecraft:shield, whereas text says diamond shield. Skipping diamond reforge does not add diamond_forged and cannot bypass final-stage lineage check.

All scripted tool/ranged/shield repair modifiers use negative additive set_damage fractions. Standard set_damage semantics may instead remove remaining durability; Java 1.21.x runtime confirmation needed. Do not conflate with change_item_damage in weapon/armor 1.21.11 enchantments.
Summoning uses execute at player, but slow_20t aging/removal uses @e without per-dimension execute. Lifetime of 600 ticks cannot be promised across Nether/End from static code alone.
Station Item History icon uses action:0, while request only handles 1..6,99,100. It is descriptive, not a history report action.
Six adaptive choices per armor type but at most five history stages; one cannot assume all six are acquired on one fresh item by station progression alone.

orphan_interpretation: No incoming literal function reference in an effective view (base alone or base plus exactly one targeted overlay) is a candidate, not a proof of impossibility. Load/tick tags included; administratively callable functions remain callable. Copper use functions are base orphans but become referenced by modern tick overlays. Catchup and ranged level_1..5 remain orphans in all seven views.

external_semantics_research.limitation: Bedrock docs alone do not prove Java behavior; repair suspicion remains explicitly unconfirmed in wiki.
